description: Add comprehensive JWT alignment tests in tests/test_jwt_alignment.py covering all Wave 1A requirements: issuer validation, dual-secret verification, user and admin token acceptance. Tests must generate actual JWT tokens using python-jose SignJWT equivalent to match SHC issuance patterns.
steps: Create tests/test_jwt_alignment.py following pytest patterns from tests/conftest.py
Add helper function to create test tokens using jose.jwt.encode with HS256, matching SHC token structure (iss, aud, tokenType, userId, originalUserId, shadowUserId, exp, iat)
Test 1: User token signed with JWT_SECRET, tokenType='user', aud='user', iss='skillhubcore.in' - must PASS
Test 2: Admin token signed with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, tokenType='admin', aud='admin', iss='skillhubcore.in' - must PASS
Test 3: Token with missing issuer - must FAIL with 401
Test 4: Token with wrong issuer (iss='attacker.com') - must FAIL with 401
Test 5: User token signed with external secret - must FAIL with 401
Test 6: Admin token signed with JWT_SECRET instead of ADMIN_JWT_SECRET - must FAIL with 401
Test 7: Token with missing identity claims (no userId) - must FAIL with 401
Test 8: Expired token - must FAIL with 401
Add docstrings explaining Wave 1A alignment objective for each test
Update services/project-ai/README.md section on JWT authentication to document SHC alignment (issuer, dual secrets, admin token support)
acceptance_criteria: Tests use actual jose.jwt.encode to generate tokens (no mocks)
Test coverage includes: issuer validation, dual-secret verification, user/admin token types, identity claims, expiration
README.md documents JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, issuer validation, and admin token support
verification: README.md has clear JWT authentication section
findings:
